svg.aria-label: Graphic placement schematic for the Jordan holiday jacquard knit sweater, size L base, front and back views with measured callouts
svg.text: JM-H26-001 · HOLIDAY JACQUARD KNIT SWEATER · SIZE L BASE · ALL DIMENSIONS IN INCHES · DRAWN TO SCALE
Cuff: 2.5 in 2x2 rib, Gym Red, linked
Collar: 1 in 2x2 rib, Gym Red, linked
Rows continuous around body and sleeves,
Best-effort match at armhole. Max float 0.5, caught.
Jumpman 1.75 x 1.5 · tree 1.5 x 1.25 · snowflake 1 x 1
Motifs centered CF and CB, symmetrical left to right
Side seam: linked, flatlock interior, no vents
Hem: 3 in 2x2 rib, Gym Red, linked, no roll
Set-in sleeve, flatlock at shoulder and underarm
Main label: woven damask, 2 x 0.75, center back neck, interior
Size tab: woven, below main label
Back neck tape: 0.75 woven twill, tonal black, heat-applied
Care label: woven satin, left interior side seam, 2 in below armhole
Gym Red · PANTONE 19-1763 TCX · Ne 20/2 cotton/elastane
12-gauge fully fashioned jacquard, knit in, not printed or applied.
Panels knit separately, linked and seamed. Enzyme wash post-knitting.
Collar, cuffs and hem: separate 2x2 rib in Gym Red, linked on, matched across all three.
Rows run continuous around the body and down both sleeves.
All interior seams flatlock or linked, no exposed raw edges.
Tolerances and graded spec S to 3XL: see measurement spec.
Graphic placement schematic · Size L base · Holiday 2026 · Rev 1.0 · Self-initiated concept, not a Jordan Brand or Nike document
